scope: Sample-only foreground SSH and main-thread VT ownership. API 27 ARM64 emulator; no business integration or Maven publication.
build: Debug, R8 release, instrumentation APK and release lint passed

lint.note: Includes WakelockTimeout: the user-started notified session deliberately owns a non-timeout partial wake lock until disconnect/failure/destruction; notification-stop release was tested.

instrumentation.note: Explicit Activity.recreate() retained service/VT identity and a live connection; unknown host key rejection and error classification passed. Plain-shell exit test skipped for tmux.

final_revision_note: Added rejection of late Activity binding callbacks after the UI cycles. Final APK passed explicit recreate instrumentation and notification disconnect/resource cleanup. The UI-cycle installed APK hash is recorded separately.
limitations: Normal screen-off only, 45 seconds per shell/vim; no forced deep Doze or vendor power policy test
